breakdown.title: Level 4
breakdown.logline: A dreamer runs endlessly up a grainy black-and-white car park stairwell marked level 4, pursued only by a still grey dog, until the roof reveals upward rain, a boat in a parking space, and a quiet float away.

colours.value: black and white, grainy, like an old film

texture.value: grainy, as if projected on film

breakdown.world_logic: The stairwell repeats level 4 endlessly; rain falls upward; a car is a wooden rowing boat; the dog is always already there.

m5.text: Camera is behind them at their eye level, using a 50mm lens, looking across the car park roof toward the edge. The concrete roof surface fills the immediate foreground, with thin streaks of rain rising from it. In the middle distance, a little wooden rowing boat stretches across the picture from left edge to right edge, low down; the dreamer is in the boat left of center, their back to the camera, and the grey dog is in the boat right of center, sitting, its back to the camera, both filling from one-third down to near the bottom edge. At the back of the picture is the edge of the roof. A single lamp post just outside the left edge of the picture casts light across the roof and onto the boat and their backs.
m5.view: Seen from behind them, from across the place, at the height of their eyes: the camera looks at a little wooden rowing boat (what the boat turned into), toward the edge of the roof. A 50mm lens. From left to right across the picture: the dreamer, left of the middle of the picture, in a little wooden rowing boat (what the boat turned into), their back to the camera, seen whole and filling the picture from a third of the way down to near its bottom; then the grey dog, right of the middle of the picture, in a little wooden rowing boat (what the boat turned into), their back to the camera, seen whole and filling the picture from a third of the way down to near its bottom. Nobody else is in the picture. They keep these places in every picture of this scene. A little wooden rowing boat (what the boat turned into), across the picture from the left edge to the right edge, with the dreamer and the grey dog in it, filling the picture from low down to its bottom edge. At the back of the picture: the edge of the roof.
